newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Unilabs restates some figures before IPO.
newsitem.headline: Unilabs restates some figures before IPO.

text.p: Unilabs SA, a Geneva-based clinical laboratory group active in Switzerland and Europe, said it had amended its historical interim consolidated financial statements as of December 31, 1996.

The correction in the interim report for the first seven months of the current fiscal year reflects reclassification of an 8.7 million Swiss franc accounting entry related to exchange rate movements, it said in a statement on the last day of bookbuilding before its shares begin trading tomorrow.

It said revenue of 70.9 million and operating income of 7.8 million remain unchanged, but the net loss for the period should be 33.2 million rather than the 24.4 million first reported and retained earnings were 16.2 million instead of 24.9 million.
Total stockholders' equity remained unchanged at 29.3 million and total assets at 133.5 million.

"Moreover, please note that all these corrections are non-cash items and that they have no impact whatsoever on the pro forma accounts or on the results expected for the fiscal year 1998 and beyond," it said.
